annotation.title_clean: Commission Directive 2014/44/EU of 18 March 2014 amending Annexes I, II and III to Directive 2003/37/EC on type-approval of agricultural or forestry tractors, their trailers and interchangeable towed machinery
annotation.title_en: Commission Directive 2014/44/EU of 18 March 2014 amending Annexes I, II and III to Directive 2003/37/EC on type-approval of agricultural or forestry tractors, their trailers and interchangeable towed machinery
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 82/20
annotation.summary_en: Commission Directive amending Annexes I–III of Directive 2003/37/EC on type-approval of agricultural and forestry tractors, updating information documents and test report templates on exhaust emissions and engine power to align with changes to Directive 2000/25/EC. Member States must transpose by 1 January 2015. No AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Amends Annexes I, II and III of Directive 2003/37/EC on tractor type-approval
Updates anti-pollution device, valve timing and engine power information document sections
Aligns exhaust emission test result templates with Directive 97/68/EC
Member States must transpose by 1 January 2015
Enters into force twentieth day after publication
